title: Kanye West Enters the Fray: Drops Scathing Remix Taking Aim at Drake and J. Cole
htmlContent:
In a unpredictable move, Kanye West has dropped a remix to Metro Boomin and Future's "Like That," the track that sparked the current Hip Hop wars. The remix, premiered by The Download With Justin Laboy on April 20, sees West taking shots at both Drake and J. Cole, further fueling the ongoing feud.

A Response to the Beef

West's verse begins by nodding to Drake's current beef with Kendrick Lamar, saying "Yo Dot, I got you." This reference is significant, as it was Lamar's shots at Drizzy and Cole on the original "Like That" that started the current back-and-forths.

Direct Shots Fired

The track then appears to reference the ongoing Diddy sexual assault allegations with the line "Can't stop, won't stop/ I just fucked your bitch in a Sean John tank top." The verse ends with direct shots at Drizzy and Cole: "Y'all so out of sight, out of mind / I can't even think of a Drake line/ Play J. Cole, get the pussy dry."

A Response to Drake's AI-Enhanced Diss

West's verse surfaced shortly after an AI-enhanced Drake diss track dropped, featuring the artificially generated voices of both 2Pac and Snoop Dogg. The track, "Taylor Made Freestyle," openly embraces artificial intelligence to press his adversary to drop a response.

The Feud Continues

The feud between Drake and Kendrick Lamar has been heating up, with both sides trading shots. Drake's latest joint, "Taylor Made Freestyle," uses AI-generated voices to reference Taylor Swift's new album and TDE boss Anthony "Top Dawg" Tiffith. The track has sparked a lot of attention, with many waiting to see how Lamar will respond.

What's Next?

According to Joe Budden Podcast host Antwan "Ish" Marby, Kendrick Lamar has a response ready to go, which is reportedly as vicious as 2Pac's "Hit Em Up." With West now entering the fray, it's clear that the Hip Hop wars are far from over. Stay tuned for further updates on this developing story.
